standard_prerequisites.name: Flat pullback of quasi-coherent modules is exact

standard_prerequisites.name: Checking a quasi-coherent module is zero
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes E = 0 from vanishing on flat points.

core_obligations: Setup: Ker(beta)/Im(alpha) computed in the etale or fppf module category agree since QCoh sits inside LQCoh^{fbc} and the cited proposition compares the two module categories (proof lines 1576-1583).

Identification: the restriction Mod(X_etale) -> Mod(U_etale) is exact, and the composite QCoh -> QCoh(U) -> QCoh(U_etale) is exact by the cited flat-pullback and comparison lemmas; hence E|_{U_etale} = (Ker/Im)|_{U_etale} (proof lines 1585-1602).

Equivalence: (1) => E = 0 so Ker/Im restricts to zero on flat points, i.e. is parasitic by definition; (2) => Ker/Im restricts to zero, hence so does E, and the qc module E is zero by the cited check-exact lemma applied to 0 -> E (proof lines 1604-1613).
proof_roadmap: Compare the two module categories via LQCoh^{fbc}.
Identify the qc cohomology object with the etale-site cohomology on flat points.
Run the equivalence in both directions.
difficulty_reason: The proof compares two restriction functors (modules on the etale site and quasi-coherent modules via pullback), both exact, to identify the qc-cohomology object E with the cohomology Ker/Im computed on the etale site; the two directions then evaluate on flat points, using the cited check-exact lemma to conclude E = 0.
